impact: Two assertions in independent 2026-10-22 verification-only Unified BRAIN run #39791707071 fail (not ok 1996 and 1998); this is not evidence that production generation or delivery failed.
fix: Update only original executable regression assertions to test the current bounded limit, cooldown selector, cooldown no-work evidence and differentiated provider deadlines; retain provider-detail sanitization, original other tests and no-double-dispatch guards.
